text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Floor Mount Door Stop / Door Holder

Stainless steel with large white rubber bumper stop for use on doors up to 2" thick. Easy to install. Concealed mounting for a clean installation. For use on residential and commercial doors.

Also available: Door Holder and Door Stop With Black Rubbers and All Stainless Glass Door Holder and Door Stop

Packaged with all necessary mounting hardware. Safe door hold open for glass doors.

Easy to operate. Simply pivot the end of the stop with your foot. The smaller rubber bumper will cradle the door holding it open. Kick it back when you want to close the door. White rubber bumpers on both sides protect your doors.

Specifications for the DWD-SIG723-630 Door Stop and Door Holder:

  • Rubber Bumper Height: 13/16" (21 mm)
  • Rubber Bumper Diameter: 1-1/4" (32 mm)
  • Total Length: 4" (102 mm)
  • Maximum Door Width: 2" (50 mm)
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

*Sold Individually



**Item Discontinued.
